title: SN 1987A — the explosion is still unfolding

segments.en: This ring glows where a dead star's shock wave struck.
segments.en_cap: This ring glows where | a dead star's | shock wave struck.

segments.en: In nineteen eighty-seven, a blue supergiant exploded.
We detected neutrinos before we saw its light.
segments.en_cap: We detected neutrinos | before we saw its light.

segments.en: Then the shock broke through the surface. The star's wreckage kept racing outward.
segments.en_cap: Then the shock broke | through the surface. | The star's wreckage | kept racing outward.

segments.en: Years later, it slammed into gas the star had shed long before it died.
segments.en_cap: Years later, it slammed | into gas the star | had shed long | before it died.

segments.en: Dense knots heated up and blazed.
segments.en_cap: Dense knots heated up | and blazed.

segments.en: The star is gone. Its shock wave is still changing the space around it.
segments.en_cap: The star is gone. | Its shock wave is | still changing the | space around it.
